purpose: Conservatively group possible same-room letter suffixes into the same split
grouping_rule: Remove trailing lowercase letter suffix after the last numeric character of the scene name; keep identical resulting group IDs in one split and exclude IDs matching previous scenes.
reason: Inspection found suffix variants across train/tune and one variant of a previously used location; suffix-based grouping is a conservative naming heuristic, not independently confirmed scene identity.
limitations: Different scene names can still refer to the same place; exclusion and grouping do not establish evaluation-scene identity or eliminate near-duplicates.
